AROIDS_CHUNKY.name: Tropical aroid / chunky mix
AROIDS_CHUNKY.light: Bright indirect to medium indirect light; protect from harsh midday sun indoors.
AROIDS_CHUNKY.water: Water when the top 30-50% of mix dries; do not leave standing in water.
AROIDS_CHUNKY.humidity: Average indoor humidity is usually workable; 50-70% helps larger leaves and velvety species.
AROIDS_CHUNKY.soil: Chunky, airy aroid mix with potting soil/coco plus orchid bark, perlite, or pumice.
AROIDS_CHUNKY.airflow: Gentle airflow helps reduce fungal issues; avoid cold drafts and heater vents.

RARE_AROIDS_HIGH_HUMIDITY.name: Rare/velvety aroid
RARE_AROIDS_HIGH_HUMIDITY.light: Bright filtered light; avoid direct sun on thin or velvety leaves.
RARE_AROIDS_HIGH_HUMIDITY.water: Keep evenly moist but never soggy; allow the upper mix to begin drying between waterings.
RARE_AROIDS_HIGH_HUMIDITY.humidity: High humidity preferred, often 60-80%, with steady warmth.
RARE_AROIDS_HIGH_HUMIDITY.soil: Very airy aroid mix with bark, perlite/pumice, coco chips, and a moisture-retentive component.
RARE_AROIDS_HIGH_HUMIDITY.airflow: High humidity should be paired with airflow to prevent leaf spotting and rot.

LOW_LIGHT_RESILIENT.name: Low-light resilient foliage
LOW_LIGHT_RESILIENT.light: Low to bright indirect light; growth is faster with brighter indirect light.
LOW_LIGHT_RESILIENT.water: Let soil dry well between waterings; overwatering is the main risk.
LOW_LIGHT_RESILIENT.soil: Well-draining indoor potting mix with perlite or pumice.
LOW_LIGHT_RESILIENT.airflow: Tolerates normal indoor air; avoid cold drafts.

FICUS_BRIGHT.name: Bright-light ficus/tree-form houseplant
FICUS_BRIGHT.light: Bright indirect light with some gentle direct sun if acclimated.
FICUS_BRIGHT.water: Water when the top 25-40% of soil dries; keep routine consistent.
FICUS_BRIGHT.humidity: Average humidity works, but avoid very dry air.
FICUS_BRIGHT.soil: Rich, well-draining potting mix; avoid compacted wet soil.
FICUS_BRIGHT.airflow: Avoid cold drafts and sudden moves; many ficus drop leaves after abrupt changes.

CALATHEA_PRAYER.name: Prayer plant / calathea humidity-sensitive foliage
CALATHEA_PRAYER.light: Medium to bright indirect light; avoid direct sun that fades or scorches leaves.
CALATHEA_PRAYER.water: Keep lightly and evenly moist; avoid fully drying out or staying soggy.
CALATHEA_PRAYER.humidity: Prefers higher humidity, often 50-70%; sensitive to dry air.
CALATHEA_PRAYER.soil: Moisture-retentive but draining mix with coco/peat and perlite.
CALATHEA_PRAYER.airflow: Avoid cold drafts, hot vents, and stagnant wet foliage.

ALOCASIA.name: Alocasia / elephant-ear tropical
ALOCASIA.light: Bright indirect light; some morning sun can work after acclimation.
ALOCASIA.water: Keep evenly moist during growth, letting the top layer dry; reduce watering in dormancy.
ALOCASIA.soil: Chunky but moisture-retentive mix; avoid dense wet soil around corms.
ALOCASIA.airflow: Good airflow helps prevent pests and fungal spots in humid setups.

PALM_TROPICAL.name: Indoor palm / tropical floor plant
PALM_TROPICAL.light: Bright indirect to medium light depending on species.
PALM_TROPICAL.water: Keep slightly moist but not waterlogged; many palms dislike drying completely.
PALM_TROPICAL.humidity: Average to higher humidity; brown tips often worsen in dry air.
PALM_TROPICAL.soil: Well-draining palm or indoor potting mix.
PALM_TROPICAL.airflow: Avoid cold drafts and hot dry vents.

BEGONIA_FLOWERING.name: Begonia / flowering foliage tropical
BEGONIA_FLOWERING.light: Bright indirect light; some morning sun can help flowering.
BEGONIA_FLOWERING.water: Let the top layer dry, then water thoroughly; avoid wet leaves and soggy roots.
BEGONIA_FLOWERING.humidity: Average to moderate humidity; airflow matters more than misting.
BEGONIA_FLOWERING.airflow: Good airflow prevents powdery mildew and leaf spotting.

FLOWERING_POT.name: Flowering potted plant
FLOWERING_POT.light: Bright indirect light; some gentle sun supports blooms.
FLOWERING_POT.water: Keep evenly moist while blooming, then adjust for dormancy or rest period.
FLOWERING_POT.humidity: Average indoor humidity works for most.
FLOWERING_POT.airflow: Avoid hot vents; remove spent blooms and yellow leaves.

SUCCULENT.name: Succulent / dryland plant
SUCCULENT.light: Very bright light; many need several hours of direct sun or strong grow light.
SUCCULENT.water: Soak thoroughly, then let mix dry completely before watering again.
SUCCULENT.humidity: Low to average humidity is fine.
SUCCULENT.soil: Fast-draining cactus/succulent mix with pumice, perlite, or grit.
SUCCULENT.airflow: Good airflow and dry leaves/crowns help prevent rot.

CACTUS.name: Cactus / arid desert plant
CACTUS.light: High light with direct sun after acclimation.
CACTUS.water: Water deeply but infrequently; keep mostly dry, especially in cool months.
CACTUS.soil: Mineral-heavy cactus mix with excellent drainage.
CACTUS.airflow: Strong airflow and fast drying reduce rot risk.

EPIPHYTE_HOYA.name: Hoya / epiphytic succulent vine
EPIPHYTE_HOYA.light: Bright indirect light; some gentle direct sun supports flowering.
EPIPHYTE_HOYA.water: Let mix dry partly to mostly between waterings; avoid heavy wet soil.
EPIPHYTE_HOYA.humidity: Average humidity works; higher humidity helps growth.
EPIPHYTE_HOYA.soil: Airy epiphyte mix with orchid bark, perlite/pumice, and light organic matter.
EPIPHYTE_HOYA.airflow: Good airflow supports healthy vines and reduces fungal issues.

ORCHID_EPIPHYTE.name: Epiphytic orchid
ORCHID_EPIPHYTE.light: Bright filtered light; avoid hot direct sun unless the species prefers it.
ORCHID_EPIPHYTE.water: Water when bark/moss approaches dry; never keep roots stagnant.
ORCHID_EPIPHYTE.humidity: Moderate to high humidity with airflow.
ORCHID_EPIPHYTE.soil: Orchid bark, sphagnum, mounted culture, or species-appropriate epiphyte media.
ORCHID_EPIPHYTE.airflow: Air movement is critical around roots and leaves.

FERN_MOIST.name: Moisture-loving fern
FERN_MOIST.light: Medium to bright indirect light; avoid hot direct sun.
FERN_MOIST.water: Keep evenly moist, not soggy; avoid drying completely.
FERN_MOIST.humidity: High humidity preferred; dry air causes crisp fronds.
FERN_MOIST.airflow: Gentle airflow helps prevent disease while retaining humidity.

AIR_PLANT.name: Air plant / tillandsia
AIR_PLANT.light: Bright indirect light with some gentle morning sun.
AIR_PLANT.water: Soak or rinse regularly, then dry fully within a few hours.
AIR_PLANT.soil: No soil; mount in a breathable display.
AIR_PLANT.airflow: Very important: plants must dry after watering.

CARNIVOROUS.name: Carnivorous bog plant
CARNIVOROUS.light: Very bright light; many need direct sun.
CARNIVOROUS.water: Keep consistently wet with distilled/rain/RO water; avoid tap water minerals.
CARNIVOROUS.humidity: Average to high depending on species; airflow still matters.
CARNIVOROUS.soil: Nutrient-poor peat/sphagnum and perlite/sand; never fertilized potting soil.
CARNIVOROUS.airflow: Use airflow to prevent mold in wet media.

HERB_MEDITERRANEAN.name: Mediterranean herb
HERB_MEDITERRANEAN.light: Full sun outdoors or the brightest indoor window/grow light.
HERB_MEDITERRANEAN.water: Let the top soil dry; avoid constant wet roots.
HERB_MEDITERRANEAN.humidity: Average to low humidity; prefers airflow.
HERB_MEDITERRANEAN.soil: Lean, very well-draining mix; add perlite, pumice, or sand.
HERB_MEDITERRANEAN.airflow: Excellent airflow improves flavor and reduces mildew.

HERB_MOIST.name: Leafy culinary herb
HERB_MOIST.light: Bright light to full sun; some afternoon shade in hot climates.
HERB_MOIST.water: Keep evenly moist but not soggy; containers dry quickly.
HERB_MOIST.soil: Rich potting mix or garden soil with good drainage.
HERB_MOIST.airflow: Airflow reduces mildew and fungus gnats.

VEGETABLE_FULL_SUN.name: Fruiting vegetable / edible starter
VEGETABLE_FULL_SUN.light: Full sun, ideally 6+ hours outdoors or strong grow light.
VEGETABLE_FULL_SUN.water: Consistent watering; avoid drought stress and waterlogged roots.
VEGETABLE_FULL_SUN.humidity: Average outdoor humidity; airflow is important.
VEGETABLE_FULL_SUN.soil: Rich, fertile, well-draining soil or container mix.
VEGETABLE_FULL_SUN.airflow: Good spacing and airflow reduce disease.

OUTDOOR_ANNUAL.name: Outdoor flowering annual
OUTDOOR_ANNUAL.light: Full sun to part sun depending on species.
OUTDOOR_ANNUAL.water: Water when the top soil dries; containers may need frequent watering.
OUTDOOR_ANNUAL.humidity: Outdoor humidity is fine; avoid crowded stagnant plantings.
OUTDOOR_ANNUAL.soil: Fertile, well-draining garden or container mix.
OUTDOOR_ANNUAL.airflow: Spacing and deadheading help reduce disease and prolong bloom.

OUTDOOR_PERENNIAL.name: Outdoor perennial
OUTDOOR_PERENNIAL.light: Match species to full sun, part sun, or shade.
OUTDOOR_PERENNIAL.water: Water to establish; many need less once rooted.
OUTDOOR_PERENNIAL.soil: Well-draining garden soil amended for the species.

SHRUB_FLOWERING.name: Flowering shrub / landscape plant
SHRUB_FLOWERING.light: Usually part sun to full sun; check species and climate.
SHRUB_FLOWERING.water: Deep watering while establishing; then species-appropriate irrigation.
SHRUB_FLOWERING.humidity: Outdoor humidity is fine; choose climate-appropriate plants.
SHRUB_FLOWERING.soil: Garden soil matched to species pH/drainage needs.
SHRUB_FLOWERING.airflow: Prune/space for airflow and bloom performance.

CITRUS_FRUIT.name: Citrus / fruiting container tree
CITRUS_FRUIT.light: Full sun outdoors; brightest possible indoor overwintering light.
CITRUS_FRUIT.water: Water deeply when the upper soil dries; avoid soggy roots.
CITRUS_FRUIT.humidity: Average outdoor humidity; indoors avoid hot dry vents.
CITRUS_FRUIT.airflow: Outdoor airflow helps pests/disease; indoor trees need inspection for scale/mites.

BONSAI_TREE.name: Bonsai / small tree in shallow pot
BONSAI_TREE.light: Very bright light; outdoor species should live outdoors.
BONSAI_TREE.water: Check often; shallow pots dry quickly but should not stay waterlogged.
BONSAI_TREE.humidity: Species-specific; indoor bonsai dislike dry hot vents.
BONSAI_TREE.soil: Bonsai mix with akadama/pumice/lava or species-appropriate gritty mix.
BONSAI_TREE.airflow: Outdoor airflow is ideal for many bonsai.

OUTDOOR_PALM.name: Outdoor palm / sun-loving landscape palm
OUTDOOR_PALM.light: Full sun is best; young plants can appreciate a gentler transition if moved from shade or indoors.
OUTDOOR_PALM.water: Water regularly while establishing, then deeply and less often once rooted; avoid constantly soggy soil.
OUTDOOR_PALM.humidity: Outdoor humidity is fine; good airflow helps keep crowns and fronds healthy.
OUTDOOR_PALM.soil: Fast-draining ground or large-container soil; avoid standing water around the crown.
OUTDOOR_PALM.airflow: Outdoor airflow is beneficial; remove crowded dead material and avoid burying the crown.

OUTDOOR_CONIFER_TREE.name: Outdoor conifer / specimen tree
OUTDOOR_CONIFER_TREE.light: Full sun to part sun depending on climate and plant age; avoid dark, crowded siting.
OUTDOOR_CONIFER_TREE.water: Water consistently while establishing, then shift to deeper, less frequent watering in well-draining soil.
OUTDOOR_CONIFER_TREE.humidity: Outdoor humidity is fine; avoid prolonged stagnant wet foliage where fungal issues linger.
OUTDOOR_CONIFER_TREE.soil: Well-draining ground soil with room for roots; avoid sites that stay waterlogged.
OUTDOOR_CONIFER_TREE.airflow: Good spacing and airflow support strong branching and reduce fungal pressure.
